design: Read-only union of actual accepted generation intervals by window/side, partitioned at the existing 60000 ms reduce-only boundary. Report side-time fraction, time with any quote, and time with both sides quoted, on 0–60 s, 60–240.1 s, and the whole window. Reconcile every phase partition and original whole-window side union exactly; retain all 288 windows, zero-presence windows and generation statuses. Generation counts describe the whole day and repeat across phase rows. No new policy, model, threshold, performance objective or selection.
motivation: After the first complete primary day, the already-declared whole-window side-time fraction was seen to include the fixed reduce-only phase. This supplement makes its denominator and the distinction between average side exposure and any-order uptime explicit. Phase-specific values have not been inspected before this declaration.
controls: Cross-boundary overlapping orders reconcile; side-time, any-side and two-side unions differ correctly. Naive summed lifetimes, missing accepted clock, duplicate generation and outside-window interval are refused.
limits: Descriptive consumed-history exposure, not executable or fillable liquidity, live uptime or a new success gate. One-day checkpoints carry no interval. Full reports require all six declared dates; original primary/stress/age conclusions remain unchanged.
